# Super mutant spawns: All locations including a map

![Supermutant Spawns: All locations including map](/uploads/749_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## Origin and creation

The super mutants of Appalachia were created through experiments with the **Forced Evolutionary Virus (FEV)**. The virus was developed by **West Tek as part of a US government research program** and was originally intended to provide protection against biological weapons. After research increasingly came under US military control, West Tek's Appalachia branch was commissioned to test FEV on humans in 2076. To do this, West Tek secretly injected a strain of FEV into **Huntersville**'s water supply, unknowingly turning the residents into test subjects. When these began to mutate, the city was sealed off and the effects of the virus were further investigated. These experiments gave rise to Appalachia's first super mutants.

After the Great War, the **Enclave under Thomas Eckhart** took up FEV research again. Eckhart wanted to increase Appalachia's automated DEFCON status in order to gain access to the nuclear missiles there. To do this, the Enclave had various threats created and released in Appalachia. With the help of West Tek's remaining research, additional **super mutants** were created, which were then released into the region.

Decades later, former West Tek scientist **Dr. Edgar Blackburn** continued FEV research. Blackburn was convinced that he could perfect the virus and thus better adapt people to the hostile world after the nuclear war. Together with other scientists, he experimented on kidnapped people and created more super mutants. Finally, Blackburn tested his improved FEV strain on himself. Instead of the hoped-for advancement, however, he transformed into a massive **super mutant behemoth** and was ultimately stopped by the Brotherhood of Steel and the Vault Dweller.
